title: HexMarksTheSpot Parser Configuration
description: JSON schema for defining file format parsers in HexMarksTheSpot

magic_bytes.description: Hex string of magic bytes (e.g., '504B0304' for ZIP)

endianness.description: Default byte order for multi-byte values

file_extensions.description: File extensions this parser handles (e.g., [".lnk", ".png"]). Used for extension-based parser matching (highest priority).

alternative_magic.description: Alternative magic byte sequences for variant formats (lowest priority matching).

bytes.description: Hex string of alternative magic bytes

offset.description: Offset where these magic bytes appear

size.description: Size in bytes or reference to another field (not required for struct/section types)

fields.description: Nested fields (for struct and section types)

oneOf.description: Mark as forensically important with default red highlighting

forensic_value.description: Mark as forensically important. Use true for default red, or a category: 'critical' (red), 'important' (amber), 'timestamp' (purple), 'identifier' (pink for GUIDs/MACs/serials), 'path' (cyan for file paths), 'network' (deep orange for network data)

oneOf.description: Statically mark this field as indicating possible anti-forensics tampering

Python expression evaluated at parse time using $field references and $_file_size. If truthy, the field is flagged as anti-forensics. Example: '$DatabaseSizeInPages != 0 and $_file_size != $DatabaseSizeInPages * $PageSize'

antiforensic.description: Anti-forensics detection. HIGHEST color precedence (black bg, red text). Use true to statically flag a field, or provide a Python expression using parsed $field values. The expression is evaluated after this field is parsed; if truthy the field is highlighted as potentially tampered. Built-in variable $_file_size provides the actual file size in bytes.

informational.description: Mark field as informational (green/teal highlighting). For descriptive metadata fields that provide context but are not forensically critical. Forensic_value takes precedence if both are set.

bit_flags.description: For bitfield type - map bit positions to names or detailed descriptions

condition.description: Conditional expression using Python syntax (e.g., '$flags & 0x01', '$value == 5 or $value == 2')

enabled.description: Set to false to skip this field during parsing. Useful for structures that exist in separate files (e.g., WAL, journal) or are not yet needed.

oneOf.description: Dynamic count reference (e.g., '$DatabaseSizeInPages', '$PageCount - 1'), 'eof' to repeat until end of file, or 'until' to repeat until repeat_until condition is met

repeat.description: Repeat a struct/section N times, by field reference, until EOF, or until a condition is met. Only valid on struct/section types. Each iteration is named Name[0], Name[1], etc.

repeat_until.description: Condition expression evaluated after each repeat iteration. When it evaluates to true, the repeat loop stops. Typically used with repeat: 'until'. Example: '$ItemIDSize == 0' to stop when a size field is zero.

repeat_step.description: Fixed byte stride per repeat iteration. Ensures each iteration starts exactly this many bytes after the previous, regardless of how many bytes inner fields consume. Useful for page-aligned structures.

oneOf.description: List of valid values. Parser logs a warning if parsed value is not in this list.

expected_values.description: Expected value constraint. If an array: parsed value must be one of the listed values. If an object with min/max: parsed value must be within range. Mismatches are logged as warnings with offset and raw hex for forensic triage.

color_gradient.description: When true on a struct/section, children inherit the parent's base color with progressively brighter tones. Creates a visual gradient indicating related fields belonging to the same logical group.

deprecated.description: Marks a field as deprecated. Unlike 'enabled: false' (which skips the field entirely), deprecated fields are still parsed and displayed but shown in a muted gray color with a deprecation notice in the description. Set to true for a generic notice, or provide a string explaining the deprecation reason or migration path.

output_format.description:
Controls how the parsed value is displayed in the Value column and Description pane. Overrides the default display derived from the field type. Available formats:
- 'hex': Hexadecimal (0xFF)
- 'decimal': Decimal integer
- 'ascii': ASCII string representation
- 'base64': Base64-encoded
- 'binary': Binary bit string (0b...)
- 'datetime_filetime': Windows FILETIME (100ns intervals since 1601-01-01)
- 'datetime_unix': Unix epoch (seconds since 1970-01-01)
- 'datetime_unix_ms': Unix epoch milliseconds
- 'datetime_dos': DOS/FAT date-time (4 bytes: 2-byte time + 2-byte date)
- 'ip4': IPv4 address (4 bytes)
- 'ip6': IPv6 address (16 bytes)
- 'size_bytes': Human-readable file size (KB/MB/GB)
- 'bool': Boolean (0=False, non-zero=True)
